subject: Bridge milestone: reprice proposal & MAP approval path
body:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acme-data.com>
Cc: Tom Cheng <tom.cheng@acme-data.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bridge milestone: reprice proposal & MAP approval path

Hi Aisha / Tom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — appreciate the candid feedback on latency and the evaluation success criteria. Attached is a compact update that aligns the MAP checkpoints to the evaluation outcomes you described and a pricing iteration that tries to balance Acme's ramp needs with our unit economics.

Key proposal (summary):
- MAP checkpoints:
  1) Evaluation POC (2 weeks) — success: model perf within agreed answer-quality thresholds.
  2) Ramp-1 (30 days after POC) — 50k token/week target, unlocks 10% committed discount.
  3) Ramp-2 (90 days after POC) — 250k token/week target, unlocks an additional 15% (stacking).
  4) Full production (180 days) — 500k token/week target, special volume slab pricing + runbook support.

- Pricing (high level):
  Option A: Conservative ramp (lower credits) — base $0.0016/token, 10% @50k, +15% @250k; trial credit $25k.
  Option B: Aggressive ramp (higher credit, earlier discount) — base $0.0018/token, up-front $40k credit, 15% @50k, +10% @250k.

Attachments: MAP_v3_Acme.pdf (MAP with checkpoints), pricing_v5.xlsx (line-item pricing + modelling), MAP_checkpoint_summary.docx (one-page checklist).

Ask: please confirm which option you prefer and who on your side owns approval of MAP checkpoints (legal or procurement). If you want, we can lock Option B for 14 days while you route internally.

Operational notes:
- We can tie the 50k/250k triggers to measured 7-day moving average usage to avoid false positives.
- SLA request: if you need a 99.9% latency SLA, we will need Dedicated capacity (we flagged capacity pricing in the pricing sheet).

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm preferred commercial option and approval owner.
2) We circulate an updated MAP doc and the SOW for signatures (DocuSign).
3) We start POC kickoff within one week of signed MAP.

Regards,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com

---

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acme-data.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Cheng <tom.cheng@acme-data.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Bridge milestone: reprice proposal & MAP approval path

Jasmine — thanks for the clear breakdown and the files. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) Discount triggers: are the percentages applied to the base per-token price or to post-quantization pricing? We need final line pricing to evaluate our internal ROI.
2) The trial credit: is that refundable if we don’t hit Ramp-1? We prefer non-conditional credits that offset first invoices.
3) Security: procurement will need our SOC2 + data retention commitments before approval. Can you attach a short evidence pack (SOC2 report reference, data flow diagram, and retention policy)?

Assignees: Procurement owns final price approval (I will loop them once we decide between A/B). Legal will want to see the exact checkpoint language.

We like Option B if we can make the $40k credit apply as an invoice offset and have a clause that preserves a minimum support window. Also, can you confirm the timeline (we may want to push Ramp-2 to 100 days vs 90).

Thanks — I’ll loop procurement once you return the security artifacts.

—Aisha
Head of AI Platforms, Acme Data
aisha.khan@acme-data.com

---

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acme-data.com>
Cc: Tom Cheng <tom.cheng@acme-data.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 02:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Bridge milestone: reprice proposal & MAP approval path

Aisha — great, thanks for the clear asks. Quick responses inline: 

1) Discount basis: percentages are applied to the posted base per-token line before quantization adjustments. We will add a worked example in pricing_v5.xlsx that shows final per-unit price after recommended quant (so you can model ROI).
2) $40k credit: we can confirm it’s an invoice offset application (non-refundable) applied to the first two invoices.
3) Security pack: attaching a short packet (SOC2_summary.pdf, data-flow.svg) — if procurement needs the full SOC2 attestation I can route the secure link via our compliance team; expect a 24–48h turnaround.

Ramp-2 timing: we can move Ramp-2 to 100 days without impact to the discount sequencing. Updated checkpoints and a compact 'acceptance checklist' are included in MAP_checkpoint_summary.docx.

Concession proposal: because Acme is driving an aggressive production timeline, I need 2 approvals from our side to lock Option B: (1) Sales manager approval for the $40k credit; (2) Finance approval on the effective discount slopes. If you want us to hold Option B for 14 days, I’ll request internal expedited approval.

I’ll loop Marissa (sales lead) and Ben (commercial ops) to request quick sign-off on Option B concessions.

Best,
Jasmine

---

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acme-data.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Bridge milestone: reprice proposal & MAP approval path

Marissa / Ben — looping you for approvals. Acme prefers Option B (aggressive ramp) if we can:
- $40k invoice offset credit (applied to first two invoices)
- 15% discount immediately at 50k token/week, +10% additional at 250k (stacking as described)
- Move Ramp-2 to 100 days (OK)
- We will provide a SOC2 summary and secure attestation link; procurement requires that before final sign-off.

Impacts and ask:
- Estimated first 90 days revenue profile (Option B) lowers realized rev by roughly $28k due to the credit; modeled in pricing_v5.xlsx.
- Approval request: please authorize the $40k credit and the 15% @50k trigger. If Finance prefers, we can convert part of the credit to extended onboarding hours rather than pure invoice offset (less direct rev impact).

Suggested approval language to send back to Acme: 
"Redwood approves Option B as presented: $40,000 invoice offset applied to the first two invoices; 15% committed discount triggered at 50k token/week (measured as 7-day moving avg); additional 10% at 250k token/week. Ramp-2 timing adjusted to 100 days. SOC2 attestation link to be provided prior to SOW signature."

If you can greenlight, I’ll send the updated MAP and SOW for DocuSign and place Option B on hold for 14 days.

Thanks,
Jasmine

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acme-data.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge milestone: reprice proposal & MAP approval path

Jasmine — after a quick review with Finance: approve Option B with one modification.

Modification: move the Ramp-1 verification window to require a sustained 60-day observation at 50k token/week (measured as rolling 7-day averages inside that 60-day window) before the 15% discount becomes billable. This reduces the immediate revenue hit while protecting the customer from spurious spikes.

Keep the $40k invoice offset as-is, but change language to allow up to 25% of the credit to be reallocated to onboarding services if Finance requests.

Please update the MAP text accordingly and circulate to Acme. Once we have the SOC2 attestation link, route both docs to DocuSign. Ben — please confirm you’re comfortable with the credit reallocation option; if so, proceed to finalize the SOW template and I’ll countersign the commercial approval.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
